blurb: Lone Rock Boat Rentals offers clean, reliable, and spacious brand new 23' Bennington pontoon boats powered by 150 HP Mercury motors. Guests can have up to 13 people on board. Boats are suitable for cruising, tubing, water skiing, and wakeboarding on Lake Powell.
